messages:
Diego Ramos: Hi! First-week question: Im a contractor starting Monday. I have a personal ThinkPad with Ubuntu 22.04 and a hardware TPM. Can that be used temporarily while my company laptop ships? Also: phishsim is Wed  if I'm still waiting on enrollment will I be locked out? Any difference for contractors on device enrollment or VPN certs?

Mara (People Ops): Welcome Diego :wave: Contractors can get a short-term BYOD exception. We require the same baseline controls but shorter cert lifetimes. Phishsim: missing it won't immediately cut access but you must complete the remedial module if you fail. @IT-helpdesk will provide the BYOD checklist and the MOU DocuSign link.

IT-helpdesk: We can onboard your ThinkPad. Quick checklist: 1) TPM present and enabled in BIOS (`ls /dev/tpm*`), 2) full-disk LUKS (prefer LUKS2) with a header backup, 3) disk health OK, 4) install our management agent. Please share `lsblk -o NAME,FSTYPE,UUID` and `uname -a` before the session.

Priya (Security): Policy notes: - BYOD requires the management agent (remote-wipe, cert escrow). - If TPM available we bind keys to TPM; otherwise we escrow keys in KMS. - Contractors: shorter VPN cert TTLs and periodic re-validation. - No automatic deprovision for missed PhishSim but repeated failures escalate.

Diego Ramos: Thanks. Two quick things: 1) I use passphrase-only LUKS (no TPM). 2) I run a local password manager and GPG keys on the machine. Any conflicts?

IT-helpdesk: Passphrase-only LUKS is acceptable with agent escrow and a strong passphrase. For GPG/password managers: fine, but don't store company certs/keys in userland without agent vaulting. We'll provision VPN certs into the agent vault.

Diego Ramos: Ok. Scheduling: can we do a 20-min walkthrough today at 3pm PT? Also where do I sign the contractor BYOD MOU?

Mara (People Ops): Sending DocuSign now. 3pm PT works, scheduling from IT. @onboarding-bot please set training due date to Friday and send PhishSim window.

onboarding-bot: Assigned trainings: "Security Quickstart" due 2025-04-25. PhishSim window: 2025-04-23 -> 2025-04-30. Reminder: 2x.

IT-helpdesk: Invite sent for 3pm PT. Diego, please paste sanitized outputs here beforehand. Pre-check script attached in the invite.

Diego Ramos: Pasted sanitized outputs: `uname -a`: Linux diego-ideapad 5.15.0-70-generic x86_64
`lsblk -o NAME,FSTYPE,UUID`:
NAME FSTYPE UUID
sda       
sda1 vfat 3C4D-5E6F
sda2 ext4 2f3a4b5c-...
sda3 crypto_LUKS 8b7c6d5e-...

Diego Ramos: I signed the DocuSign MOU. Thanks all, see you at 3pm!
